I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket number is **#8841**.

Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support.

His message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was talking about "Tobias's dealer account," and a Central team summary from January says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5. That's why I think it's the same account, but I can't confirm it from what Pree can see. I told her that and suggested she check with Tobias before the call.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public Central team files. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
